scope.paired: Same source, public options, fixed measurement/clock and exact SVG+dimension verification. JS raw model render compared with Rust typed retained and mutable publication APIs; publication returns an additional cloned graph.
scope.nativeComponents: Separate native API components, not matched JS operations or end-to-end Swift costs.
scope.excluded: Startup, module loading, process setup, NDJSON control pipe, SVG DOM insertion, layout/paint and GPU. JS GC during a batch remains part of observed runtime.
scope.externalLoad: Host is not assumed globally idle. External xctest may consume one core; unrelated processes are never stopped.
